svg.title: MiniFrontier Modern global block
svg.desc: Interior of a global layer: pre-RMSNorm, grouped-query attention with QK-norm then RoPE or NoPE and full causal span over all history, a residual add, a second pre-RMSNorm, SwiGLU feed-forward and a second residual add. Only the attention differs from a local layer.
svg.text: skeleton identical to a local block
q / k / v proj · 4 q, 2 kv — same as local
QK-norm on q, k → then RoPE, or NoPE
full causal — every token back to position 0
coral — the only sublayer that differs from a local block
